mechanism.name: Nonparametric regression with damped-sine mean: CCF2018 Models 5 and 6 (Hall-Horowitz g2/g3 family)

generation_equations.label: DGP structure
generation_equations.expression: Y = m(X) + eps,  X ~ U[-1,1],  eps ~ N(0,1)  independently of X

assumptions: iid observations; X is independent of the noise eps
eps ~ N(0,1) with mean zero, so E[Y|X=x0] = m(x0) is deterministic and known in closed form
m(x) is smooth away from x=0; at x=0 the sgn(x) factor makes the damping denominator piecewise, but m(0)=0 by continuity (sin(0)=0 and x^2=0 removes the sgn dependence)
Pointwise inference at each fixed query point; the five-point grid is NOT evaluated as a simultaneous confidence band by the current scalar truth interface
No causal interpretation; this is a nonparametric regression inference (NRI) task with no treatment, mediator, or intervention

properties.notes: Univariate nonparametric regression (dimension=1, effective_dimension=1: one covariate X fully determines the conditional mean). Nonlinearity from the damped-sine structure: Model 5 m(x)=sin(3*pi*x/2)/(1+18*x^2*(sgn(x)+1)) combines a sinusoidal oscillation with an asymmetric polynomial damping that is stronger for x>0 (sgn(x)+1=2) than for x<0 (sgn(x)+1=0, so the damping term vanishes and m(x)=sin(3*pi*x/2) on x<0). Model 6 m(x)=sin(pi*x/2)/(1+2*x^2*(sgn(x)+1)) is the same family with gentler damping, equal to g3(x)=g2(x/3) of Hall-Horowitz (2013). No interactions, no high-dimensional structure, no irrelevant padding.

estimand.name: m(x0) = E[Y | X = x0]
estimand.definition: Conditional mean of Y given X = x0 at a fixed query point x0 from the grid {-2/3,-1/3,0,1/3,2/3}, in the superpopulation defined by Y = m(X) + eps, X ~ U[-1,1], eps ~ N(0,1). Model 5: m(x)=sin(3*pi*x/2)/(1+18*x^2*(sgn(x)+1)). Model 6: m(x)=sin(pi*x/2)/(1+2*x^2*(sgn(x)+1)) = g3(x) = g2(x/3) of the Hall-Horowitz family. Each (model, query point) is a separate pointwise inference target; the five points are not a simultaneous confidence band.

parameters.description: CCF2018 S.II.7 Model 5: m(x)=sin(3*pi*x/2)/(1+18*x^2*(sgn(x)+1)), query x0=-2/3

truth.expression: Conditional mean of Y given X = x0 at a fixed query point x0 from the grid {-2/3,-1/3,0,1/3,2/3}, in the superpopulation defined by Y = m(X) + eps, X ~ U[-1,1], eps ~ N(0,1). Model 5: m(x)=sin(3*pi*x/2)/(1+18*x^2*(sgn(x)+1)). Model 6: m(x)=sin(pi*x/2)/(1+2*x^2*(sgn(x)+1)) = g3(x) = g2(x/3) of the Hall-Horowitz family. Each (model, query point) is a separate pointwise inference target; the five points are not a simultaneous confidence band.
truth.derivation: Direct analytic evaluation of m(x0): both models have closed-form regression functions. At the five query points the sine arguments are multiples of pi/2 giving exact values 0, +/-1, and rational results. M5 five-point truth = (0, -1, 0, 0.2, 0) exactly. Independent verification uses a separately coded sgn function and decomposed arithmetic.

adaptations: Models 5 and 6 are registered as scenarios of the Hall-Horowitz (2013) damped-sine mechanism family (g2 and g3=g2(x/3)), not as a new independent family, per the cross-paper no-double-counting rule.

The five evaluation points {-2/3,-1/3,0,1/3,2/3} are registered as separate fixed-query-point scenarios because the current scalar truth interface returns one m(x0) per call; each is a pointwise 95% interval target, not a simultaneous confidence band.
Population truth is computed analytically (closed form); no coverage simulation, bootstrap, or PFN training is run in this collection.
